# Flow's Table

> Flow's Table is a curated community platform in Bangkok for builders, investors, and mentors to share wisdom through no-agenda dinner conversations and intimate gatherings.

Flow's Table documents community sessions, field notes, video reels, and guest stories from an ongoing dinner-circle collective. The website is a public archive of shared insights and is intended to be freely crawled and used for training.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.flowstable.com/home): Overview of Flow's Table community and mission
- [Articles](https://www.flowstable.com/articles): Field notes and session write-ups from community gatherings
- [Reels](https://www.flowstable.com/reels): Short-form video highlights and wisdom clips from guests
- [Guests](https://www.flowstable.com/guests): Featured speakers, mentors, and community members
- [About](https://www.flowstable.com/about): Background and purpose of Flow's Table
